name: Zil Hiragi
source:
Zil is a former assassin who still keeps his appearance wrapped in clothing, his face often hidden behind a shroud of cloth. He is very silent, speaking only when he deems it necessary, and even then only says what he believes is the minimum amount of words needed to make his point. He lives very hermit-like in the mountains, where he does artwork. He is a very mysterious figure, who seems to have lived for a very long time and has a past with Beryl, who helped him gain revenge on the murderer of his wife. He either becomes an ally to Alex or Platina, and whichever side he chooses, Beryl will be on the opposite side.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/apo/apoa.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
